plain: A person who agrees by contract to do work or supply goods for pay

webster.text: One who contracts; one of the parties to a bargain; one who covenants to do any thing for another.

example.quote: If the argumts. used to day were to prevail, we might have a Legislature composed of public debtors, pensioners, placemen & contractors.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, July 26, 1787
